default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-918.title: Dollar leads index (inverse lag)
E-918.hypothesis: WIN and WDO move inversely and the dollar futures often reprice first; when WDO moves unusually far over a short window while WIN has not yet moved against it, slower index participants catch up in the opposite direction.

E-919.title: Bollinger band re-entry fade
E-919.hypothesis: A close outside a rolling 2-sigma band that closes back inside is an overshoot whose stop-driven buyers/sellers are exhausted; fade toward the mean.

E-920.title: VWAP sigma-band re-entry fade
E-920.hypothesis: Session VWAP with the session's own deviation band marks where intraday inventory is stretched; a close back inside the band after an excursion means the push is spent.

E-921.title: Donchian midpoint cross
E-921.hypothesis: The midpoint of the N-minute channel is the balance price; a close crossing it shows buyers or sellers taking control of the range.

E-922.title: Chaikin money flow threshold cross
E-922.hypothesis: Volume-weighted close location over the window shows accumulation or distribution; crossing a threshold marks informed flow whose move should continue.

E-923.title: Autocorrelation-regime big-bar trade
E-923.hypothesis: When recent bar returns are positively autocorrelated a large bar is followed, when negatively autocorrelated it is faded; the rolling regime selects the side.

E-924.title: Three-EMA ribbon alignment onset
E-924.hypothesis: When price and three EMAs line up in order, short- and long-horizon traders agree on direction; the first bar of full alignment starts a leg.

E-925.title: Compression then expansion bar
E-925.hypothesis: After a few bars much quieter than the last 30 minutes, a wide bar closing at its extreme shows resting liquidity was consumed; follow the release.

E-926.title: Wide-day session midpoint cross
E-926.hypothesis: On days that have already ranged widely, the midpoint of the session range is the acceptance line; a close across it shows the day's control flipping.

E-927.title: Index-vs-dollar ratio mean reversion
E-927.hypothesis: The log ratio of WIN to WDO is anchored by the common macro driver; a stretched ratio z-score means one leg overshot, and WIN tends to be the leg that reverts.
